mechanism: A-TR1: _attention_rotation_signs takes only the seed, but the call sits inside a for block_size in (16,32,64) x for seed in (0,1,2,3) double loop. At this shape seeds 0, 1 and 2 produce the identical sign vector (sha256 prefix 6c4b415a) and only seed 3 differs (5bb2a9c6), so each block re-scored the same candidate three times. The candidate state is a function of (signs, block) and not of the seed, and the selection is a strict `<` on a score that is therefore also identical, so a duplicate can never change the argmax. Skipping duplicates is exact.
why_this_form_was_chosen: This card was found by profiling rather than by guessing a mechanism. The profile showed _dense_to_hif4 is 75.9% of one attention calibration call, 10.33s of that reached through hif4_dynamic_quantize_q/k, and 6.95s of THAT through one line, _attention_deployed_mse:2891. Content-hashing every call's (q_state, k_state) together with its line number showed 7 of 16 calls recomputing an already-scored state pair.

methodology.how_found: perf profile -> call-site attribution -> content-hash duplicate detection
methodology.redundancy_rule: same call site AND identical arguments AND identical state -- see defect #39 for why all three are required

equivalence.criterion: byte-for-byte equality of hif4_calibration_attention state AND of the dynamic q/k/v outputs

timing.note: Both device paths measured; unlike v243/v244 they AGREE in direction, because this card removes real computation (duplicate candidate encodings) rather than moving cost between device-bound and dispatch-bound work.
timing.no_extrapolation: No official seconds predicted, no local-to-official factor derived. The official judge is a Kunpeng 920B CPU whose torch.cuda.is_available() is false; neither local path reproduces it exactly.

cumulative_over_v237.note: product of the three successive per-parent ratios, not a sum; each card was measured against its own parent

purity.method: byte-level replacement, uniqueness assert, head/tail byte-identity, segment comparison across the hunk

defect_39.what: The card's first draft also claimed lines 10217/10647 were a duplicate. That was wrong: the redundancy signature hashed only (q_state,k_state) and not the other arguments, and those two sites pass different ones (full lists vs a validation_* subset).
defect_39.fix: Claim withdrawn; rule recorded -- a redundancy signature must cover the function's complete argument list.
